instruction: Single Office Result From Init Package. Work in the opened OpenStudio application, starting from the Desktop input files init.osm, weather.epw and workflow.osw. The init model is a related single-office shell with the required story, space, zone, envelope and load metadata, but it is missing the two required fixed-window subsurfaces. Use init_plan.png on the Desktop as the visual reference for the target layout. Modify the model rather than replacing the task package with an unrelated file. Save result.osm in the task output folder. Create 1 building story, 1 space and 1 thermal zone. Name the OS:Space Office. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 6 total OS:Surface objects, split into 1 floor surface, 1 roof/ceiling surface and 4 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 1 Ground and 5 Outdoors. Add 2 OS:SubSurface objects, all of them FixedWindow windows, with total fixed-window area 24.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 1 ideal-loads air system, 1 zone HVAC equipment list, 1 dual-setpoint thermostat, 1 people definition, 1 lights definition and 1 electric equipment definition. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 15.00 m in X, 10.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 150.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 160.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
